summary: Backend-only smoke + CRUD test for Excel Maps API. All 18 targeted checks passed including root, MS OAuth URL construction & state persistence, callback error paths (400 for missing/invalid state), auth guards (401 for missing/invalid session on protected routes), full Maps CRUD via injected fake session, point override put/delete, and logout invalidation.
passed: GET /api/auth/microsoft/url builds correct authorize URL with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, scope, and state UUID
oauth_states document is persisted for issued state
GET /api/auth/me with injected valid session returns user info
notes: Graph-calling endpoints (/onedrive/files with valid session, sheets, /maps/{id}/data) were intentionally skipped as they require a real Microsoft OAuth token. All in-scope MongoDB-backed flows verified. Test data (fake session and map) cleaned up at end of run.
